source.retry_after: Seconds of the Retry-After header; null when the header is not sent. The server sends it on every 429 and 503, as a positive whole number of at most 86400.
source.examples: Values the server builds per response are examples: subscription_inactive, push_limit_reached, the json_invalid list, invalid_modules and the skew window. The payload_invalid body is from a server test run.
